verdict.rationale: Babylon.js ships literal 'Sandbox' and 'Playground' testing environments (sandbox.babylonjs.com, playground.babylonjs.com) plus a NullEngine for headless/offscreen testing without a real rendering context, which could serve as isolated test environments for code/scenes. However, as a client-side rendering library it has no 'production data' concept or documented workflow framing this as agent-safe sandbox testing distinct from production. Missing for 10: explicit framing of sandbox vs production data separation, agent-oriented CI/test isolation guidance, and independent corroboration of this specific use case.
